title: The Last Extraction
author: Marguerite Dunmore
blurb: Lior Underhill, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
